name: agy
description: Adversarial code review via agy (Google Antigravity CLI). Runs Gemini 3.7 Flash read-only against your actual repo so it can follow call sites, not just critique a pasted diff.

interface.shortDescription: Adversarial code review from Gemini, with real repo access
interface.longDescription: Delegates adversarial review of your current diff to Gemini 3.7 Flash via the agy (Antigravity) CLI. The reviewer runs read-only but with read access to the whole repository, so it greps for call sites and verifies findings against real code instead of critiquing a pasted diff — catching breakage in files the diff never touched. Includes a credential pre-flight, since the diff leaves your machine.
defaultPrompt: Get an adversarial review of my current diff with agy
Have agy red-team this change before I merge it
Ask agy to challenge the design of this change, not just the bugs
Ask agy for a second opinion on the staged changes, focusing on auth
